changes.title: Trump says new talks are 'last chance' for Iran to forge a deal
changes.summary: Trump said in the Oval Office on Monday he expects negotiations that will reopen the Strait of Hormuz and create a pathway for Iran to address the United States' concerns about its nuclear program will begin in the next day or two.

changes.title: Takeaways after Trump takes questions on Iran, Reflecting Pool in Oval Office
changes.summary: President Trump took reporter questions on the Iran war, the renovation of the reflecting pool in Washington, D.C., and more on Monday. CBS News' Lindsey Reiser and Natalie Brand share their biggest takeaways.

changes.title: Trump touts new nuclear reactors in his push to speed up domestic power
changes.summary: President Donald Trump hosted executives from nuclear power companies Friday in the Oval Office to celebrate a new milestone in the White House's push to accelerate the growth of nuclear power in the United States.

changes.title: Trump says he doesn't see a lot of "evil" in Lindsey Graham's death when asked about FBI probe
changes.summary: President Trump took questions in the Oval Office and commented on an apparent FBI probe into Lindsey Graham's death, saying he doesn't see a lot of "evil" behind the sudden incident.
